power.jaymospowers.reactor.desc: A heart like the reactors of the ruined future beats in your chest. Running, landing from a height and above all being hurt fill its charge; full, it detonates round you and you take none of it. Your own blasts never hurt you, and no block is broken by them.
power.jaymospowers.reactor.key.starter: Cone Burst (weak): a punched wave of air and heat in a cone ahead, for a little charge
power.jaymospowers.reactor.key.ability_1: Cone Burst: a punched wave of air and heat in a cone 6 blocks ahead; harms and throws back
power.jaymospowers.reactor.key.ability_2: Blast Dash: blast off along your look, the blast behind you hurting what stood there. Sneak + %2$s: Recoil, blast what's in front and be thrown backwards
power.jaymospowers.reactor.key.ability_3: Shell Beam: a shell of light down your look, up to 48 blocks, bursting where it hits. Sneak + %3$s: Charged Throw, your held item (one of the stack) thrown to burst where it lands
power.jaymospowers.reactor.key.ability_4: Hold: the Drill, the stone, dirt, sand or gravel you look at comes out as its items, a block at a time (1 charge each); never an ore, never anything made. Sneak + %4$s: Ground Crack, a slam that splits the ground 8 blocks ahead
power.jaymospowers.reactor.key.mode: The dial: how much of your charge each move pours in (a quarter, a half, all of it). The more it spends, the harder it hits
power.jaymospowers.reactor.key.mode.name: Dial
power.jaymospowers.reactor.key.ultimate: Hold 5 s, let go: the Nuke, every bit of your charge in one blast 14 blocks round you, leaving fallout that sickens everyone in it but you for 30 s
message.jaymospowers.reactor.overload: Your heart overloads and bursts round you
message.jaymospowers.reactor.nothing_hel: Nothing in your hand to throw
message.jaymospowers.reactor.drill_no: The drill takes only the ground as it lies
message.jaymospowers.reactor.nuke_wait: The heart isn't ready to go off again: %ss
